summary: The public TypeScript API of @flyingrobots/geordi-compiler-core (every entry point in its package.json exports) is now a contract the gate compares. The API itself did not change; this record starts the contract's history.
why: flyingrobots/geordi#219 added the typescript-api surface and registered every published package under typescriptPackages in contracts/registry.json. A contract that is new against the base needs a record.
